_meta.note: NEGATIVE evidence for member_thread_tools, kept so the miss is measured rather than re-probed blind. Driven over stdio by scripts/capture_muse_member_dispatch.py (--mount stub, --mode readOnly, --settle 20): session/new carried exactly one element, a one-tool stub server behind mcp_http_relay (stdio is refused -32602), mode readOnly set over session/set_mode. The relay child logged every MCP method serve sent it (STUB_LOG): none arrived across the settle wait and the whole turn, so serve never dialed the mounted server. The model listed native tools only, replied NO TOOL FOUND, raised no session/request_permission, and ended the turn. On adapter 0.11.0 driving host 1.4.15 (the muse CLI auto-updated past the measured 1.4.14). Run and request uuids read CALL-<n> in order of appearance, the session uuid reads SESSION and the working directory reads ~/work; available_commands_update, session_info_update and agent_thought_chunk frames are dropped as the corpus requires. Re-run this drive after a host or adapter change before claiming the dispatch round trip.
